ValidationRule.description: Users are required to provide a reason for why they entered an ARR Adjustment
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules), NOT(ISCHANGED( ARR_Adjustment_Reason__c)), OR( ISCHANGED(ARR_Adjustment__c), ISCHANGED(Exit_ARR_Adjustment__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When an adjustment to ARR is made, a reason for the adjustment must be provided
